summary: A fortified complex featuring a central asymmetrical building with horizontal striped walls and a stepped brick roof, surrounded by four tall, detached watchtowers at the corners of a rectangular perimeter marked by spaced white blocks.

shape.overall_form: central building with four detached corner towers

rebuild_hints: Lay out the rectangular perimeter using spaced white blocks and place the four watchtowers at the exact corners.
Construct the central building using an asymmetrical, multi-winged footprint as seen from the top-down views.
Alternate horizontal layers of the yellow block (e.g., sandstone) and white block (e.g., quartz) for the main building walls.
Build the watchtowers with solid grey stone corners and yellow block centers, leaving gaps for glass pane windows.
Use brick blocks/stairs to create the stepped gable roof on the main building, and outline the edges with stone slabs.
Cap the watchtowers with flat, overhanging roofs made of brick and stone slabs, topped with a central light source.
uncertainties: Exact block types for the yellow and white materials (could be sandstone/end stone and quartz/white concrete/iron).
Interior layout and floor divisions are completely obscured.
Exact block count for dimensions is estimated due to perspective and distance.
